text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed the injured Curren Bouquetd'or to 
the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I thought I was being 
careful, but...
choice_data_list:
It's okay. Right now, you just need to get 
plenty of rest.

It's okay. Right now, let's just get 
plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: Wait, do you want to train?
Wait, do you want to train?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...If I were unable to race due to 
injury, it would become—the Trainer's 
responsibility..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
So that you get the recognition you 
deserve, Trainer— that is the whole reason 
I run, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm telling you I'm fine... I have to 
show everyone that I was made strong 
enough not to be defeated by any injury—
choice_data_list:
I'd hate to see you suffer if that injury 
gets worse.

I don't want to see you suffer if your 
injury gets worse.

...If you're going that far, shall we go 
check it out?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm telling you I'm fine... I have to 
show everyone that I was made strong 
enough not to be defeated by any injury—
choice_data_list:
I'd hate to see you suffer if that injury 
gets worse.

I don't want to see you suffer if your 
injury gets worse.

...If you're going that far, shall we go 
check it out?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: That is... I suppose, yes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Trainer is someone who cares about us 
Umamusume... more than anyone else...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And yet, here I am…… asking you to look 
the other way while I push myself too 
hard.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It seems... I was rushing things. I am 
truly, deeply sorry...
choice_data_list: You just focus on healing your injury
You just focus on healing your injury.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—once I return, to make up for the time 
off, I will dedicate myself to training 
even more rigorously—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Curren Bouquetd'or entered a 
period of brief rest.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes, then—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I'm sorry for being so 
selfish—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her injury being more severe than 
anticipated, Curren Bouquetd'or was forced 
into a period of convalescence.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's head back to the track—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... whew...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness—as long as I don't move 
too violently, it doesn't seem to hurt..."
choice_data_list: Still, let's wrap it up in moderation.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You're right... If I push too hard and 
make it worse, it'll all be for nothing, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I will recover properly and prove that 
your guidance, Trainer, was not mistaken.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to taking things steadily without 
rushing, Curren Bouquetd'or's recovery 
proceeded smoothly.
